aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description:
I'm a Software Engineer with 4 years of industry experience, a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering, and I'm currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science. Throughout my career, I've worked across both back-end and front-end development, with a strong focus on designing scalable, reliable, and maintainable back-end systems.

My primary technologies include Java, Spring Boot, Python, AWS, TypeScript, and Angular. I also have experience with automated testing, continuous integration, cloud-based applications, and software architecture, always aiming to build high-quality solutions that are efficient, maintainable, and user-focused.

Alongside my professional work, I'm pursuing research in Artificial Intelligence as part of my PhD. Since my undergraduate studies, research has been a significant part of my journey, allowing me to explore emerging technologies, contribute to the scientific community, and bridge the gap between academic research and industry practice.
